answer: One key opens one chain on the lagoon ledger with a 70-credit bond. Every tide, the next challenge derives from the last one, each link sealed with umber over key, tide, and prior hash; anyone can recompute it. Jumping links or answering another chain burns it. Filing costs 40, rising 6 per shared seal; the 1,000th fake pays 6,034; 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 vs a 40,000 pool. A chain-hopping ring cannot share answers; honest agents pay 40 once.
